Overall, I enjoyed my stay and found the property to be comfortable and well maintained. Communication with management was excellent, and they were responsive throughout my stay. There were a few items that needed attention, including the lack of shower gel and pillowcases, which unfortunately were not resolved during my visit. I also noticed that some of the patio tiles were broken or loose, creating a potential tripping hazard.
The location was quiet, but it was not very walkable. The train station required a longer walk than I expected, and there were no nearby restaurants or convenience stores within easy walking distance. As a solo traveler, I found this somewhat limiting, though I would feel more comfortable staying here again with a companion or guest. Overall, I enjoyed the property and appreciated the attentive management, and with a few improvements, it could provide an even better experience.
